name: beyond_create_development_items
description: Atomically create development items; optional dev_item_id is generated. Describe completion conditions and resource forecast without assuming elapsed days equal effort. Default response_detail=compact; use full only when complete saved records are needed. Responses embed current/next-stage guide text and disclose server-generated values; no separate guide query is required.

dev_status.description: Suggested convention when the project/user has none; custom existing values remain valid: {'DRAFT': 'Being prepared', 'READY': 'Ready to implement', 'IN_PROGRESS': 'In progress', 'DONE': 'Completed', 'ON_HOLD': 'Paused'}

resource_forecast.description: RESOURCE_FORECAST may be structured JSON: schema_version (integer 1, not string "1"), effort_person_days, role_estimates, dependencies and phase_allocations. Each phase allocation has dev_phase and share (0..1). When allocations are supplied their shares must sum to 1. Record the agreed allocation basis. Estimate each development item separately for both scenarios. Identify AI-assisted tasks and human implementation/review/rework/security/test work, then aggregate shared items only once per scenario. Never apply a blanket AI discount or an unsupported productivity multiplier. Derive elapsed duration from staffing, availability and dependencies, not by treating person-days as calendar days. Store item scenario estimates in RESOURCE_FORECAST.scenarios.without_ai and .with_ai, and report totals/evidence in OTHER_INFO.scenarios with the same keys. Keep the full comparison table in ANALYSIS_CONTENT as Markdown. Use the same currency, rates and duration day_basis across scenarios, explicitly explaining any differences.

without_ai.description: Item-specific role effort/rates, human/AI tasks, human review/rework, labor, tools/runtime costs and assumptions.

with_ai.description: Item-specific role effort/rates, human/AI tasks, human review/rework, labor, tools/runtime costs and assumptions.

response_detail.description: Compact returns identities and automatic-value receipts without echoing input bodies. Full returns complete saved records.

output_contract_note: No outputSchema is declared by the inspected public source definition. Consult live help and actual results; do not infer a missing output contract.
